trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: I assume that she is guilty because of her fingerprints.
trap.right: I presume that she is guilty because of her fingerprints.
trap.why: Português “presumir/assumir” se confundem; presume baseia-se em indícios, assume é ponto de partida, e assumir uma culpa é admit.

mcq.q: Let us ___ for the argument that it is true.

fix.wrong: She assumed the guilt and confessed.
fix.right: She admitted the guilt and confessed.

fix.wrong: Let us presume it is true, for argument.
fix.right: Let us assume it is true, for argument.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por presumes: “The court takes innocence as the default by rule.”
Troque por assume: “Let us take it as true for argument.”
rewrite.answer: Let us assume it is true.
